authority: Taylor, 2026-10-25: remove score from the gate; report Q1, Q4 and mean on every return, and identify death causes when measured.
scope: Prospective policy. No training, evaluation, retry, resume or checkpoint promotion is authorized by this definition.

supersedes.scope: Future score-based pass/fail requirements only. Historical frozen runs, receipts and verdicts remain unchanged.

development.pilot: Require strict improvement in mean alive frames; score improvement is no longer a pass/fail condition. Retain finite-data, reward-accounting and gradient checks.

bootstrap.note: Keep the existing conservative survival bound; do not loosen it when removing the two score checks.

unchanged: Environment, architecture, observation allowlist, action repeat and episode accounting.
Reward: actual score delta + 0.01 per alive raw frame - 5 once on termination; learner scale 0.1.
Seed reservations, deterministic argmax, paired baseline, cap handling and held-out separation.
Complete receipts, ownership, resource bounds, exact identities and parent acceptance remain mandatory.
Failed-run weights remain ineligible under their existing contracts.

reporting.Q1: Arithmetic mean of the lowest quarter of episode values, not the 25th-percentile cutoff.
reporting.Q4: Arithmetic mean of the highest quarter of episode values, not the maximum or 75th-percentile cutoff.
reporting.current_64_episode_evaluations: 16 episodes per quartile; rank each metric independently; retain fractional frame means.
reporting.units: Alive raw frames and seconds at 60 Hz.
reporting.score: Diagnostic only; retain Q1, Q4 and mean in performance reports.
reporting.provenance: Name checkpoint/cohort; distinguish best development selection from final and held-out results.
reporting.death_causes: Report measured counts/fractions and survival by cause, including unknown and truncations separately. Do not infer causes from entity presence or partial observations.

integration.requirements: Future runner registration must bind this policy and enforce survival-only predicates. Existing dev_eval.py and identity.py remain tied to the retained v2 protocol; do not run them as v3 or weaken their identity checks.
